story: In-person early voting starts Monday, Oct. 19. So far only mail ballots are in: 52,342 statewide, from voters 65 and older, voters with disabilities and a few others.

Harris County has 18,162 mail ballots back. In 2022 it had about 22,647 (adjusted for registration growth) by the end of the first day of early voting, so it is at 80% of that level with a day of mail still to come.

Many counties have not posted mail counts yet, including Bexar, El Paso, Hidalgo, Brazoria, Galveston, Parker. The statewide total will jump when they do, so it is too early to compare Texas as a whole with past years.
Starting Monday, this page compares every county's turnout with the same day in 2022 and estimates whom the mix of voters favors.
Turnout shows where votes come from, not whom they are for.
